docs.title: Muslim Administration
docs.text: History of Muslim Administration, Course 403 (মুসলিম প্রশাসনের ইতিহাস).

docs.title: Question bank: mid-term and final, 2016–2021
docs.text:
View · Download

Past mid-term and final exam questions, 7th semester. Topics covered: administration of the Prophet, sovereignty in Islam, Khilafat, Makka city state, Zakat, Majlis-us-Shura, Umayyad and Abbasid administration, judicial system, finance and revenue, Delhi Sultanate (royal household, provincial government), Sher Shah's reforms, Mughal central administration, Mansabdari system, Kabuliyat and Patta, Village Panchayet.

docs.title: The Art of Arabic Calligraphy (slides)
docs.text:
View · Download

Lecture slides by AKM Khademul Haque, University of Dhaka. Development of the Arabic script, Ibn Muqla's proportional system, al-aqlam al-sitta, Kufic, Thuluth, Naskh, Ta'liq, Diwani, Riq'a, Tughra, pictorial calligraphy, calligraphy in architecture.

docs.title: Mosque and temple differences (handwritten notes)
docs.text:
View · Download

Handwritten notes in Bengali (মসজিদ ও মন্দিরের পার্থক্য): architecture as the matrix of civilization, Hindu temple and mosque compared, differences in ornamentation, with references (Percy Brown, R. Nath, Creswell, S.M. Hasan).

docs.title: Muslim tomb architecture (book chapters)
docs.text:
View · Download

Chapters from বাংলাদেশের মুসলিম সমাধি স্থাপত্য by Ayesha Begum (আয়শা বেগম): origin and development of Muslim tomb architecture (মুসলিম সমাধি স্থাপত্যের উৎপত্তি ও বিকাশ), and tombs in India outside Bengal: Sultan Ghari, Iltutmish, Tughlaq, Lodi, Humayun, Taj Mahal.
